title: Create invoice from the menu and the Finance tab works as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status In Progress, billable, with one line not yet Complete.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, in status Complete, billable.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  3. Open work order 2.
  4. Open the Finance tab.
  5. Click Create invoice on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu offers "Create invoice".

Step 3:

  • Work order 2 opens.

Step 4:

  • The Finance tab offers "Create invoice".

Step 5:

  • The invoice is created and shows on the Finance tab.
